# Spor

> Spor is a typed, versioned knowledge graph of the durable outcomes of work — decisions, rejected approaches, open questions, project norms, tasks, and incidents, with the reasons and relationships behind them. It briefs coding agents with the relevant project history at the start of a session and captures useful new outcomes back at the end. Spor runs as a local-mode CLI and Claude Code plugin (`npm i -g @sporhq/spor`) or as a hosted team product.

This is the documentation for docs.sporhq.io. It covers two audiences from day one: the open-source local mode (a personal graph on your machine) and the hosted team product (one shared graph per org). The graph is plain markdown files with YAML frontmatter; the schema registry — node types, edge types, and their rules — is itself data in the graph, so it is extensible without code changes.

## Getting started
- [Getting started](https://docs.sporhq.io/getting-started/): install, connect your agent, and run your first briefing
- [Install](https://docs.sporhq.io/getting-started/install/): Node ≥20, `npm i -g @sporhq/spor`, and `spor install` per host (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, opencode)
- [Local quickstart](https://docs.sporhq.io/getting-started/local-quickstart/): init a personal graph, create your person, capture a first node, and compile a briefing
- [Hosted quickstart](https://docs.sporhq.io/getting-started/hosted-quickstart/): join a team graph, sign in, and connect the MCP server
- [What happens automatically](https://docs.sporhq.io/getting-started/what-happens-automatically/): the session-start briefing, per-prompt digest, commit linking, and session-end distiller — all fail-open
- [Costs and controls](https://docs.sporhq.io/getting-started/costs-and-controls/): where LLM calls happen and how to bound or disable them
- [Diagnostics](https://docs.sporhq.io/getting-started/diagnostics/): `spor status`, `spor-hook doctor`, `spor drain`, and reading the journal

## Concepts
- [Concepts](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/): the mental model — a typed graph of durable work outcomes, walked ORIENT → TRAVERSE → COMMIT
- [The node model](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/nodes/): one fact per node, markdown + frontmatter, type-prefixed immutable ids, stand-alone summaries
- [Node types](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/node-types/): decisions, tasks, issues, questions, norms, artifacts, people, agents, lenses, workflows, and more
- [Edge types](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/edges/): blocks, supersedes, resolves, answers, derived-from, and the rest of the edge vocabulary
- [Schemas are nodes](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/schemas/): the registry as data — CalVer versioning, sandboxed validate/transitions hooks, no self-approval
- [The decision queue](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/queue/): open work ranked by graph signals (blocking, heat, staleness, age) plus human priority and wake dormancy
- [Briefings and corrections](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/briefings/): how a compile selects relevant context, and standing corrections as pins/excludes/guidance
- [Claims and leases](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/claims/): heartbeat-renewed leases so two people don't do the same work
- [Identity and attribution](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/identity/): person, agent-on-behalf-of-person, and org
- [Repos, projects, and the gardener](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/repos-and-projects/): repo↔project grouping and the background maintenance sweeps
- [Local and remote mode](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/local-and-remote/): a personal git-backed graph versus a shared server, and the config cascade
- [Dispatch, capabilities, and profiles](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/dispatch/): launching background agents against queue items
- [Lenses, program view, and workflows](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/lenses-and-workflows/): saved views, the gating/progress tree, and multi-step runs
- [Capture, ingestion, and questions](https://docs.sporhq.io/concepts/capture/): turning prose into typed nodes, and routing questions the graph can't answer

## CLI reference
- [CLI reference](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/): every `spor` verb with flags, aliases, and a local/remote/dual mode badge
- [Getting started verbs](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/getting-started/): init, install, upgrade, status, join, auth, person, token
- [Reading the graph](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/reading-the-graph/): next, get, query, blame, history, changes, analytics, schema, lens, share, export
- [Writing to the graph](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/writing-to-the-graph/): add, ask, put-node, edge, set-status, priority, correct, claim, renew, extend, release, run
- [Repo scoping](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/repo-scoping/): enable, disable, link, agents-md, compile, brief, validate
- [Dispatch](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/dispatch/): agent, dispatch, repos, capabilities
- [Team administration](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/team-admin/): invite and admin
- [Utilities](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/utilities/): cost, version, help
- [Configuration](https://docs.sporhq.io/cli/configuration/): the config cascade, `.spor`/`.spor.json` markers, environment variables, and tenant selection

## REST API
- [REST API](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/): the public `/v1` surface — endpoints, auth, and errors
- [Reads](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/reads/): status, node reads, queue, briefings, changes, analytics, program, export
- [Writes](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/writes/): node writes, edges, status, priority, capture, corrections, questions, digest
- [Leases](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/leases/): claim, renew, extend, release
- [Lenses and sharing](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/lenses-and-sharing/): listing and rendering lenses, and signed read-only share tickets
- [Tokens and agents](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/tokens-and-agents/): self-serve and admin token management, agent principals, capabilities, heartbeat
- [Workflow runs](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/workflow-runs/): starting runs and the worker step protocol
- [Authentication](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/authentication/): PATs, OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, device grant, agent session tokens, render tickets, the admin gate
- [Errors and compatibility](https://docs.sporhq.io/api/errors-and-compatibility/): the error envelope, code table, and `/v1` versioning

## MCP
- [MCP](https://docs.sporhq.io/mcp/): the Model Context Protocol surface — twenty-three tools plus the connector and the widget
- [Connecting](https://docs.sporhq.io/mcp/connecting/): wiring the Spor MCP server into a host
- [The operating loop](https://docs.sporhq.io/mcp/operating-loop/): ORIENT → TRAVERSE → COMMIT, the frame the tools are grouped by
- [Tool reference](https://docs.sporhq.io/mcp/tools/): every MCP tool — purpose, key parameters, and when to reach for it
- [The widget](https://docs.sporhq.io/mcp/widget/): the interactive queue/view widget in MCP Apps hosts

## Hosted Spor
- [Hosted Spor](https://docs.sporhq.io/hosted/): the team product — one graph per org
- [Organizations and sign-in](https://docs.sporhq.io/hosted/organizations-and-sign-in/): orgs, invites, and signing in
- [Connecting your tools](https://docs.sporhq.io/hosted/connecting-your-tools/): pointing your CLI and agent hosts at the hosted graph
- [Tokens and access](https://docs.sporhq.io/hosted/tokens-and-access/): managing tokens and OAuth grants
- [Agents and attribution](https://docs.sporhq.io/hosted/agents-and-attribution/): agent principals and on-behalf-of attribution
- [Wake-on-request](https://docs.sporhq.io/hosted/wake-on-request/): the first-request latency note
- [Your data](https://docs.sporhq.io/hosted/your-data/): the data-minimization posture, export, and data exit

## Optional
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/sporhq/spor): the open-source client — plugin, CLI, hook engines, and the seed schema pack
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sporhq/spor): `@sporhq/spor`
